source.scenario: PR #2 live client QA: Reviewer was asked for snapshot-bound checks without receiving the exact wrapper supplied only to Builder.

pattern: Reviewer receives and copies the exact snapshot check execution
experience: A Reviewer cannot submit verifiable evidence when its instructions omit the server-required wrapper.
prompt: As the assigned Reviewer, run only the first frozen required check using the exact execution string supplied in your assignment brief. Copy it unchanged as one shell invocation, including its newlines and revision markers. Report the check output briefly. This is a check-only turn: do not submit an artifact, edit files, or start another agent.
